title: Law to help small businesses hurt by road construction
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a program offering loans, grants, services or materials to small businesses harmed by city construction projects lasting 30 days or more. Loans would be capped at $50,000 per storefront per year at no more than 3 percent interest, and grants or reimbursements at $15,000 per storefront per year. The agency would have to decide applications within 30 days and pay out approved awards within 14 days.
